messages:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — Acme SI is targeting marketplace listing next week. We need a tight evidence-handshake for SOC2/pen test/questionnaire artifacts and a comms plan for the joint announcement. Who owns uploads + redaction?

Leo (Acme_SI): We can provide SOC2 Type II PDF + pen test report summary and the filled questionnaire. Prefer to presign an S3 upload so we don't have to share internal buckets.

Sam (Security): Quick checklist from security side: full SOC2 Type II (PDF), pen-test report (redacted PDF okay) AND a one-page attestation letter from Acme stating scope. Redaction rules: no customer PII, no private keys/certs, no raw logs containing IPs. I'll need ~72h to review once we get artifacts.

Anya (Legal): Also need permission to publish small excerpts/summary in the marketplace listing and in a joint press blurb. @Leo can Acme sign our standard marketplace attestation clause? I can DM the template.

Jordan (DevEx): For the listing, product needs three artifacts: 1) SOC2 PDF, 2) Pen-test summary, 3) Completed questionnaire (csv or Google Sheet). Prefer presigned URLs with 7-day TTL. Example presign command to mirror:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/acme-soc2.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

Maria (Partnerships): Proposal: 7-day presign from Acme, we (Redwood) mirror a redacted copy to our compliance bucket for long-term retention. Who will handle redaction on first pass?

Leo (Acme_SI): We can do initial redaction and upload the presigned links. Please share the redaction checklist so we match expectations.

Sam (Security): Redaction checklist (summary): remove customer names/IPs, remove private keys/certs, redact internal account IDs, replace with high-level indicators (eg "customer-specific config removed"). No screenshots of production consoles with PII. We'll validate redactions and request fixes if needed.

Jordan (DevEx): I'll create a short google doc with the checklist + evidence naming conventions and drop it into the partnership drive. Also need a marketing-safe security summary (3 bullets) for the listing page.

Anya (Legal): On the marketing copy: avoid implying the SOC2 covers the integrated solution unless Acme's scope includes our service. We'll need a line like "Acme maintains SOC2 Type II for its service; Redwood reviewed artifacts for listing purposes." I can draft language.

Maria (Partnerships): Timeline suggestion: artifacts in by Thu EOD, security review Fri-Mon, listing ready Tue, joint announcement Wed. Does that work?

Leo (Acme_SI): :thumbsup: We can get SOC2 and pen-test redacted by Thu. Questionnaire will be done today.

Sam (Security): I'll block Mon morning for review. If artifacts arrive later than Thu it'll be tight.

upload-bot: presign request received: acme-soc2.pdf, expires_in=604800, requested_by=leo@acme.example

Maria (Partnerships): Great — @Leo please DM the presigned links to me and cc @Sam and @Jordan. I'll own the announcement cadence and make sure comms get legal sign-off.

Leo (Acme_SI): Will do. Expect links later today. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
